values.value: Postman env vars cannot hold true comments, so this one is the note. baseUrl/rootUrl are set for a local server on :4000. accessToken + refreshToken are filled automatically by the "Auth > Login" test script — leave them blank. workspaceId: REPLACE the placeholder with a REAL workspace id after you log in — run "Workspaces & Team > List My Workspaces" (or "Quickstart Demo Flow > 02 List Workspaces", which sets it for you). Every /workspaces/:workspaceId/* and /store/:workspaceId/* request needs it. cartToken is filled by "Cart > Create / Get Cart".
